Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing an E85 motor fuel tax rate.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to E85 fuel tax rates; adding a new section tochapter 82.36 RCW; providing an effective date; and declaring anemergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The tax rate on E85 motor fuel shall be seventyone percent of thestate's motor vehicle fuel tax rate that is in effect at the time ofsale. As used in this section, "E85 motor fuel" means an alternativefuel that is a blend of denatured ethanol and hydrocarbon thattypically contains eightyfive percent by volume, and complies withASTM specification D579899.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectJuly 1, 2007.
